title: Autumn Empanadas with Apple Filling
description: A twist on traditional Italian pastries, these empanadas are filled with a sweet and tangy apple mixture, perfect for the autumn season.

ingredients.name: empanada dough
ingredients.amount: 1 package (usually found in the frozen food section of most supermarkets)

instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apple, cinnamon, nutmeg, and brown sugar.
Place a spoonful of the apple mixture onto one half of the empanada dough.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling, pressing the edges together to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges of the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
